Feeling a bottom soon. Stonk is still the only venue on Solana that provides any sustained runners. Pump is a solved game. Tokens run, top at a few M, and rug. 

If your a trader looking for more than one leg, STONK is the only place you can find that. 

We sit at a crossroads. Stonk bleeds to Zero, or we see more deployers choose Stonk over pump. I think with MASK running, and eco holding much better than the pump eco, we still have a good shot at attracting many more deploys when the market picks back up again. 

Revenue has undeniably dropped, but the same can be said for every crypto protocol over the past weeks. The question becomes how likely it is to bounce back when the market goes risk on again. 

If we haven't died yet, tough to think we would when the market comes back. Can we remain resilient until then? Well, if we keep producing runners, (like mask) you'd have to think STONK should persist. 

Let's see
